data.name: StoneGate
data.description:
### StoneGate


##### Preview: [Youtube Video](https://youtu.be/b0FxEZ6X6_o)


### Works On:
- Multiplayer
- Singleplayer
- Dedicated Server


### StoneGate Tool Modes:
- Mark (Used for marking objects you want to be in the gate, except for rotation object)
- Rotate (Used for selecting where the rotation point of the gate should be, NOTE: Only 1 object can be selected)
- Delete (Used for deleting a Stone Gate)

Stone Gate Tool Is One Time Use, And Need To Be Crafted Agian For Each Gate You Want To Create


### HotKeys:
- `C` To Change Stone Gate Tool Mode
- `E` To Complete Stone Gate
- `Left Button Click` To Select Gate Objects
- ALL THESE KEYS CAN BE CHANGED IN MOD SETTINGS (NOTE: UI key icons won't change, but updated button will work)
